title: Alex’s Immortal
reviewNotes: All 58 saved states and narration reviewed. This is a middlegame king hunt from a developed position: the bishop/knight offers, ...e5+, ...Bg4+, ...Bh4, queen invasion and final ...Qg6 mate. Queens, rooks, minor pieces and many pawns remain throughout. No worked endgame position or conversion is presented. It remains discoverable as a channel tactic, outside the endgame-study scope.
